desc: Derive and verify reverse processing: value `i` occupies the `P_i`-th still-empty final position when processed from `N` down to `1`.
Implement a Fenwick tree with initialization of all positions as free, removal updates, and binary lifting lower-bound search.
Build the final answer by processing `i = N` down to `1`, placing each value at its selected free position.
Handle efficient stdin parsing and space-separated stdout output.
Run the completed program on the provided sample cases.
